method: Every public evidence record linking to The Tortoise Table was fetched (one request per 1.5 s, robots.txt allows general agents). The common name, Latin name and feeding classification on the page were compared with the record. Wrong-plant links were corrected to the page found through the site search for the recorded plant; verdicts were not changed.
